import autogen

llm_config = {"model": "gpt-4o-mini", "api_key": "...", "temperature": 0}

researcher = autogen.AssistantAgent(
    "researcher",
    system_message="You search for and retrieve relevant passages on the given question.",
    llm_config=llm_config
)
drafter = autogen.AssistantAgent(
    "drafter",
    system_message="You write clear responses using passages provided to you.",
    llm_config=llm_config
)
critic = autogen.UserProxyAgent(
    "critic",
    human_input_mode="NEVER",  # fully automated
    code_execution_config=False,
    system_message="You identify weaknesses in drafts and return a revision list."
)

groupchat = autogen.GroupChat(
    agents=[researcher, drafter, critic],
    messages=[],
    max_round=6  # prevents infinite loops
)
manager = autogen.GroupChatManager(groupchat=groupchat, llm_config=llm_config)
researcher.initiate_chat(manager, message=q)
description: AssistantAgent and UserProxyAgent in a GroupChat where all agents share the same messages list, with GroupChatManager deciding who speaks next.

steps.description: Three agents: researcher and drafter as AssistantAgent, critic as UserProxyAgent with NEVER human input mode.
Researcher: AssistantAgent with system message for searching and retrieving passages.
Drafter: AssistantAgent with system message for writing from provided passages.
Critic: UserProxyAgent with system message for identifying weaknesses, no human input, no code execution.
GroupChat: agents list, empty messages, max_round=6 to prevent infinite loops.
Manager: GroupChatManager with the groupchat, then researcher initiates the chat with the question.
